mod.overview: Extreme (Jason Avina, February 2000) applies heavy anti-skiing traction and drag to Base Tribes, speeds up Blaster bolts, locks Scouts to Light Armor while opening APCs to Medium/Heavy, and prevents mines from hurting teammates in objective modes.
notes: Anti-skiing physics (ArmorData.cs): raises drag 10x (1.0 -> 10.0), groundTraction 9-10x (3.0 -> 30.0 Light/Med, 4.5 -> 40 Heavy), and groundForce (to 99x mass) while lowering jumpImpulse (75 -> 60 Light, 110 -> 75 Med, 150 -> 100 Heavy). Also removes Grenade Launcher from Light Armor.

Gameplay changes: Blaster muzzleVelocity increases from 200 to 350 m/s; Vehicle::onCollision only restricts Scout piloting to Light Armor (allowing Medium/Heavy in LAPC/HAPC); AntipersonelMine::onCollision skips friendly/self-team detonation in CTF, D&D, C&H, and F&R missions.

Blaster.summary: Blaster bolt muzzleVelocity increases from 200 m/s to 350 m/s while damage (0.125) and fire rate stay stock.
notes: Makes Blaster shots noticeably easier to lead at mid-range.

MineAmmo.summary: Mines ignore friendly players in CTF, D&D, C&H, and F&R missions.
notes: Prevents teammates from accidentally tripping defensive mines on their own stand.
